words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-pra-√yam

hindi: बेचकर पण्य न सौंपने वाले को बारह पण का दण्ड, दोष, उपनिपात, असह्य को छोड़कर।
english: For one who, having sold wares, does not deliver [them], the penalty [is] twelve paṇas, except in cases of defect, mishap (upanipāta) and the unbearable (aviṣahya).
notes: Verbless: 'is' supplied in brackets in English. 'Deliver': aprayacchataḥ = not giving over (pra-√yam); the object is not stated, [them] is supplied. daṇḍa = penalty (Book 4 usage); paṇa is a unit name. The three exceptions are defined in units 2-4. doṣa, upanipāta, aviṣahya are taken as a dvandva; the ablative with anyatra is rendered 'except in cases of'.
lines_deva: विक्रीय पण्यम् अप्रयच्छतो द्वादश.पणो दण्डः, अन्यत्र दोष.उपनिपात.अविषह्येभ्यः
lines_iast: vikrīya paṇyam aprayacchato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, anyatra doṣa.upanipāta.aviṣahyebhyaḥ

english: The defect of the wares [is] the defect (doṣa).
notes: A definition: the doṣa of unit 1 is a defect in the wares. Verbless; no copula supplied in Hindi.
lines_deva: पण्य.दोषो दोषः
lines_iast: paṇya.doṣo doṣaḥ

words.gloss: obstruction by king, thieves, fire, water

hindi: राजा, चोर, अग्नि, जल की बाधा — उपनिपात।
english: Obstruction [caused by] king, thieves, fire [or] water [is] the mishap (upanipāta).
notes: Definition of upanipāta (literally 'befalling'). 'Obstruction by' vs 'obstruction of' (bādha) is left open; the bracketed '[caused by]' is the more natural reading. 'agny.udaka' is regular sandhi for agni-udaka; no flag.
lines_deva: राज.चोर.अग्न्य्.उदक.बाध उपनिपातः
lines_iast: rāja.cora.agny.udaka.bādha upanipātaḥ

hindi: बहुत गुणों से हीन अथवा पीड़ित के द्वारा किया हुआ — असह्य।
english: [That which is] lacking in many qualities or made by the afflicted [is] unbearable (aviṣahya).
notes: Definition of aviṣahya. bahu-guṇa-hīna: 'lacking many qualities' (alternative: 'much lacking in quality'). ārta-kṛta: 'made by the afflicted' (alternative: 'made in distress'); the sense is doubtful, so rendered literally. 'That which' is supplied in brackets.
lines_deva: बहु.गुण.हीनम् आर्त.कृतं वा-अविषह्यम्
lines_iast: bahu.guṇa.hīnam ārta.kṛtaṃ vā-aviṣahyam

hindi: वैदेहकों का अनुशय एक रात, कृषकों का तीन रात, गोरक्षकों का पाँच रात।
english: For traders the anuśaya (regret) [is] one night, for farmers three nights, for cattle-keepers five nights.
notes: anuśaya kept as a term; literally 'regret, repentance'; here evidently a period within which a sale or purchase may be reversed (not stated by the word itself). Verbless; the genitives are rendered 'for'. vaidehaka = trader.
lines_deva: वैदेहकानाम् एक.रात्रम् अनुशयः, कर्षकाणां त्रि.रात्रं, गो.रक्षकाणां पञ्च.रात्रम्
lines_iast: vaidehakānām eka.rātram anuśayaḥ, karṣakāṇāṃ tri.rātraṃ, go.rakṣakāṇāṃ pañca.rātram

hindi: मिश्र और उत्तम वर्णों के जीविका-विक्रय में सात रात।
english: For the mixed and the highest varṇas, in the sale of livelihood, seven nights.
notes: vyāmiśra and uttama could be two groups of varṇas (taken so) or vyāmiśra could qualify something else. vṛtti-vikraya: 'sale of livelihood' is literal; it may mean sale of the goods that form their livelihood (not stated). Verbless; the anuśaya is understood from unit 5 but not supplied.
lines_deva: व्यामिश्राणाम् उत्तमानां च वर्णानां वृत्ति.विक्रये सप्त.रात्रम्
lines_iast: vyāmiśrāṇām uttamānāṃ ca varṇānāṃ vṛtti.vikraye sapta.rātram

hindi: आतिपातिक पण्यों का अनुशय “अन्यत्र बेचने योग्य नहीं” — अवरोध से दिया जाना चाहिए।
english: For ātipātika wares the anuśaya is to be given by restraint, “not to be sold elsewhere”.
notes: ātipātika is obscure and is kept untranslated (from atipāta, 'passing by, urgency'; 'perishable' is a possible sense). avarodha: 'restraint' (alternatives: 'confinement, stoppage'); the exact construction of avarodhena with the quoted phrase is uncertain. The quotation marks are balanced in the e-text. The closing iti is carried by the quotation marks.
lines_deva: आतिपातिकानां पण्यानां "अन्यत्र.अविक्रेयम्" इत्य् अवरोधेन-अनुशयो देयः
lines_iast: ātipātikānāṃ paṇyānāṃ "anyatra.avikreyam" ity avarodhena-anuśayo deyaḥ

words.gloss: a tenth part of the wares

hindi: उसका अतिक्रमण होने पर चौबीस पण का दण्ड, अथवा पण्य का दसवाँ भाग।
english: In transgression of that, the penalty [is] twenty-four paṇas, or a tenth part of the wares.
notes: tasya refers to the rule of unit 7 (the restraint); atikrama = transgression. 'catur' before v- is regular sandhi for catuḥ. daśa-bhāga = a tenth part (not 'ten parts').
lines_deva: तस्य-अतिक्रमे चतुर्.विंशति.पणो दण्डः, पण्य.दश.भागो वा
lines_iast: tasya-atikrame catur.viṃśati.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, paṇya.daśa.bhāgo vā

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-prati-√grah

hindi: खरीदकर पण्य न लेने वाले को बारह पण का दण्ड, दोष, उपनिपात, असह्य को छोड़कर।
english: For one who, having bought wares, does not take [them] over, the penalty [is] twelve paṇas, except in cases of defect, mishap (upanipāta) and the unbearable (aviṣahya).
notes: Parallel to unit 1 for the buyer.
lines_deva: क्रीत्वा पण्यम् अप्रतिगृह्णतो द्वादश.पणो दण्डः, अन्यत्र दोष.उपनिपात.अविषह्येभ्यः
lines_iast: krītvā paṇyam apratigṛhṇato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, anyatra doṣa.upanipāta.aviṣahyebhyaḥ

hindi: और अनुशय विक्रेता के अनुशय के समान।
english: And the anuśaya [is] equal to the seller's anuśaya.
notes: The anuśaya is not stated to be the buyer's; it follows unit 9 (buyer). Not supplied. samāna with instrumental: 'equal with'.
lines_deva: समानश् च-अनुशयो विक्रेतुर् अनुशयेन
lines_iast: samānaś ca-anuśayo vikretur anuśayena

words.gloss: from the taking of the hand

hindi: किन्तु पहले तीन वर्णों के विवाहों का उपावर्तन पाणिग्रहण से सिद्ध, और शूद्रों का प्रकर्म से।
english: But for the marriages of the first three varṇas the upāvartana (turning back) [is] established from the taking of the hand, and of the Shudras [it is established] from the prakarman.
notes: upāvartana: literally 'turning back'; here the reversal of the marriage. prakarman is obscure ('beginning, undertaking') and kept untranslated. 'Shudras' in the genitive plural is read with the elided upāvartana. siddha: 'established, valid'. Reviewer: the sense 'beginning, undertaking' above is a guess. Glossary 4.12 lists prakarman under pra-√kṛ = act upon; the term is kept untranslated here and a person should decide the sense.
lines_deva: विवाहानां तु त्रयाणां पूर्वेषां वर्णानां पाणि.ग्रहणात् सिद्धम् उपावर्तनं, शूद्राणां च प्रकर्मणः
lines_iast: vivāhānāṃ tu trayāṇāṃ pūrveṣāṃ varṇānāṃ pāṇi.grahaṇāt siddham upāvartanaṃ, śūdrāṇāṃ ca prakarmaṇaḥ

words.gloss: of the two whose taking of the hand has taken place

hindi: पाणिग्रहण हो चुके दोनों का भी औपशायिक दोष देखकर उपावर्तन सिद्ध।
english: Even of the two whose taking of the hand has taken place, the upāvartana [is] established on seeing an aupaśāyika defect.
notes: vṛtta-pāṇigrahaṇa taken as a dual bahuvrīhi 'whose hand-taking has taken place' (alternative: a dvandva 'of the vṛtta and the pāṇigrahaṇa'). Dual genitive is read; a locative 'when ... has taken place' is also possible. aupaśāyika is obscure (from upaśaya, 'remedy, relief') and kept untranslated.
lines_deva: वृत्त.पाणि.ग्रहणयोर् अपि दोषम् औपशायिकं दृष्ट्वा सिद्धम् उपावर्तनम्
lines_iast: vṛtta.pāṇi.grahaṇayor api doṣam aupaśāyikaṃ dṛṣṭvā siddham upāvartanam

words.gloss: indeed (na tu eva = not at all)
of the two who have had offspring

hindi: किन्तु सन्तान उत्पन्न कर चुके दोनों का बिलकुल ही नहीं।
english: But [it is] not at all [so] of the two who have had offspring.
notes: Elliptical: the upāvartana of unit 12 is understood but not supplied in Hindi. abhiprajāta: 'who have had offspring born' (alternative reading 'on whom offspring has been born'); doubtful.
lines_deva: न त्व् एव-अभिप्रजातयोः
lines_iast: na tv eva-abhiprajātayoḥ

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. pra-√dā

words.gloss: giving back of bride-price and woman's property

hindi: औपशायिक कन्या-दोष को बताए बिना कन्या देने वाले का छियानवे का दण्ड, और शुल्क, स्त्रीधन को लौटाना।
english: For one who gives away the girl without declaring an aupaśāyika defect of the girl, the penalty [is] ninety-six, and the giving back of the bride-price [and] woman's property.
notes: Unit of the ninety-six is not stated (not supplied). 'Girl' (kanyā) kept literal. śulka = bride-price in this marriage context (elsewhere toll). strī-dhana = woman's property, literal. 'ṣaṇ.ṇavatiḥ' = ṣaṭ + navatiḥ, regular sandhi. 'ṣaṇ.ṇavatir' dotted as a compound by the editors.
lines_deva: कन्या.दोषम् औपशायिकम् अनाख्याय प्रयच्छतः कन्यां षण्.णवतिर् दण्डः, शुल्क.स्त्री.धन.प्रतिदानं च
lines_iast: kanyā.doṣam aupaśāyikam anākhyāya prayacchataḥ kanyāṃ ṣaṇ.ṇavatir daṇḍaḥ, śulka.strī.dhana.pratidānaṃ ca

words.gloss: loss of bride-price and woman's property

hindi: अथवा वर के दोष को बताए बिना विवाह करने वाले वरण करने वाले का दोगुना, और शुल्क, स्त्रीधन का नाश।
english: Or for the chooser who marries [her] without declaring the defect of the groom, [the penalty is] twofold, and the loss of the bride-price [and] woman's property.
notes: varayitṛ (one who chooses, i.e. in marriage) is rendered literally; vindataḥ (marrying, vid as in 3.2) has no stated object, so [her] is bracketed. 'Twofold' is understood of the penalty of unit 14 (dvi-guṇaḥ with daṇḍaḥ not stated). Whether the one who conceals is the groom or his party is not stated.
lines_deva: वरयितुर् वा वर.दोषम् अनाख्याय विन्दतो द्वि.गुणः, शुल्क.स्त्री.धन.नाशश् च
lines_iast: varayitur vā vara.doṣam anākhyāya vindato dvi.guṇaḥ, śulka.strī.dhana.nāśaś ca

hindi: किन्तु द्विपदों और चतुष्पदों के कुण्ठित, रोगग्रस्त, अशुद्ध को उत्साही, स्वस्थ, शुद्ध बताने में बारह पण का दण्ड।
english: But for bipeds and quadrupeds, in the declaring of [the] dull, diseased [or] unclean [as] energetic, healthy [or] clean, the penalty [is] twelve paṇas.
notes: The two genitive groups (kuṇṭha... and utsāha...) are read as 'declaring dull etc. as energetic etc.'; '[as]' is supplied. kuṇṭha: 'dull, blunt' (the opposite of utsāha, energy), rendered 'dull'; alternative 'lame'. Hindi lacks the verb; the sense 'declaring X as Y' is carried by बताने में.
lines_deva: द्विपद.चतुष्पदानां तु कुण्ठ.व्याधित.अशुचीनाम् उत्साह.स्वास्थ्य.शुचीनाम् आख्याने द्वादश.पणो दण्डः
lines_iast: dvipada.catuṣpadānāṃ tu kuṇṭha.vyādhita.aśucīnām utsāha.svāsthya.śucīnām ākhyāne dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ

hindi: चतुष्पदों का उपावर्तन “तीन पखवाड़े तक”, मनुष्यों का “एक वर्ष तक”।
english: For quadrupeds the upāvartana [is] “up to three fortnights”, for human beings “up to a year”.

text_flags.why: closing iti with no opening quotation mark or introducing verb in the unit; no change proposed (possible)

notes: pakṣa = fortnight here (not 'wing'). iti closes each short quoted period; carried by the quotation marks. The e-text prints ā as a dotted compound member.
lines_deva: आ.त्रि.पक्षाद् इति चतुष्पदानाम् उपावर्तनम्, आ.संवत्सराद् इति मनुष्याणाम्
lines_iast: ā.tri.pakṣād iti catuṣpadānām upāvartanam, ā.saṃvatsarād iti manuṣyāṇām

hindi: क्योंकि उतने समय में शौच और अशौच को जानना शक्य।
english: For by that much time [it is] possible to know cleanness and uncleanness.
notes: Verbless; '[it is]' supplied in brackets. Reason clause for the periods in unit 17. kāla with tāvatā: 'in/by that much time'.
lines_deva: तावता हि कालेन शक्यं शौच.आशौचे ज्ञातुम्
lines_iast: tāvatā hi kālena śakyaṃ śauca.āśauce jñātum

hindi: जिस प्रकार दाता और प्रतिग्रहीता क्षतिग्रस्त न हों, उस प्रकार देने या खरीदने में सभासद अनुशय करें।
english: In the way that the giver and the receiver may not be injured, in that way the members of the assembly should make the anuśaya in giving or buying.
notes: kuryuḥ ... anuśayam: 'make the anuśaya' (i.e. fix or arrange it); rendered literally. upahata = injured, harmed. sabhāsad: literally 'sitters in the assembly'. Verse (anuṣṭubh), two half-lines; the closing verse of the section.
lines_deva: दाता प्रतिग्रहीता च स्यातां न-उपहतौ यथा
दाने क्रये वा-अनुशयं तथा कुर्युः सभासदः
lines_iast: dātā pratigrahītā ca syātāṃ na-upahatau yathā
dāne kraye vā-anuśayaṃ tathā kuryuḥ sabhāsadaḥ
